# Tiny Apertus oracle

Synthetic random weights, seed 2217, generated by `../../generate-apertus-reference.py` with PyTorch 2.14.1 and Transformers 4.57.6. No pretrained weights or downloaded data are included.

The two-layer, width-16 config exercises GQA, Q/K normalization, Llama 3 RoPE scaling, xIELU, and a separate output head. `reference.json` holds CPU f32 logits and every hidden state. The companion `../apertus-bf16/` checkpoint and reference verify BF16 initialization and forward execution.
